response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), mix_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS avg_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / m.baseline) AS avg_relative_to_mix, AVG(u.ownership - o.baseline) AS avg_excess_ownership FROM units AS u JOIN mix_baselines AS m ON u.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.baseline;
